# Hongchen Lingjing — deterministic verification for AI-computed numbers

We build three tools around one idea: AI-computed numbers must be checkable, deterministically, before anyone acts on them. No confidence scores, no vibes — three verdicts only: verified, refuted, unverified (honest abstention).

## Lingshu Solver — deterministic equation engine for AI agents (≤6 vars; fast, correct, decision-ready)

- Hosted MCP endpoint: `https://hongchenlingjing.com/mcp` (streamable HTTP)
- Web app: <https://hongchenlingjing.com/>
- Free: web / `npx lingshu-solver` / hosted endpoint (honorPaid free pass). Commercial use needs written permission from the copyright holder (see LICENSE).
- **Agent contract:** same input always returns the same answer — no LLM, no randomness, no hallucination. Every `solve` result carries a `trust` block that tells the agent what to do next — read it before anything else. `conclusion` is one of four states (all / partial / none / budget-exhausted); `trust.trustLevel` (8 levels) + `trust.agentAction` is the executable instruction (branch on it, do not count solutions yourself); `trust.meaningOfEmpty` separates *proven* no-real-solution from *not found within budget* from *input not solvable* — an empty result is never silently "no solution". `verify` returns the corrected value plus how far off the original was, so a wrong number becomes a repair rather than a retry loop.

## Lingjing — personal AI brain / knowledge library (bring your own key)

- <https://hongchenlingjing.com/lingjing-en/>

## LingNao — AI number verification API (verify the numbers your AI produces)

- Playground: <https://hongchenlingjing.com/verify/>
- API: `POST https://hongchenlingjing.com/verify` — body `{"caseLabel":"...","items":[{"id":"i1","kind":"algebraic","payload":{"equations":["x+2=5"],"claimed":{"x":3}}}]}`; three verdicts only: verified | refuted | unverified; English in, English out.
- Claim kinds (`items[].kind`): `algebraic` (equations + claimed), `membership` (claimed value ∈ certified solution set), `entail` (∀ certified solutions satisfy a boundary), `consistency` (≥2 statements mutually non-exclusive), `constraint`. `items[].depends:[id]` builds a DAG; the kernel topologically sorts it, refuses on cycles (422), and composes by `∃ refuted ⇒ refuted; else ∀ verified ⇒ verified; else 𝕌`. Optional `items[].tol` (relative, capped at 1e-3) and request-level `budget` (default 200 primitive evaluations; unaffordable items abstain as `abstainedBy:"budget"`).
- **Variable names.** Multi-character names work when declared in `variables` `["subtotal","tax","total"]`: the solver keeps them whole and echoes the resolved list in `varNames`. With `variables` empty the default is single-letter product parsing (`xy` → `x*y`); if that would exceed the 6-variable cap the engine switches to whole-identifier reading and flags `interpretation:"whole_identifier_fallback"`. Read `varNames` back before trusting `values`.
- Integration guide (JS / Python / LangChain / OpenAI tool schema / MCP snippets): <https://hongchenlingjing.com/verify/integrate.html>
- MCP (stdio): `npx lingnao-mcp` — one gateway tool `lingnao`

## Scope and refusals (by design)

Medical, mental-health, education & training, investment or financial advice, and legal advice are refused (HTTP 422, `compliance:true`). A verification service must refuse what it cannot check.
